@graph.name: Projects From The Projects
@graph.description: Experimental software tools, documentation systems, and learning environments focused on node-based programming and signal flow.

@graph.name: Wireup Outpost
@graph.description: A patch-aware assistance system for TouchDesigner networks. The system reads patch state through wireup.tox, interprets operator behavior, traces signal flow, and provides layered explanations during live patch construction.
featureList: Interactive query interface during patch construction

@graph.name: TouchDesigner Signal Flow Ontology

@graph.name: Node
@graph.description: A functional unit in a visual programming graph representing an instantiated operator.

@graph.name: Operator
@graph.description: A computational component that processes signals within a TouchDesigner network.

@graph.name: Signal
@graph.description: Data transmitted between operators in a TouchDesigner network.

@graph.name: Network
@graph.description: A directed graph of interconnected operators forming a signal-processing pipeline.
